introduction_markdown: Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL questions. Section I is designed to be answered in 1 hour and Section II in 1 1/2 hours; you are advised to divide your time accordingly. In Section II, answer all questions choosing EITHER parts a, b and c OR parts d, e and f of each question. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Where necessary, assume: the acceleration of free fall, $g = 10\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$; the speed of light in air, $c = 3\times10^{8}\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$; the charge on an electron, $e = 1.6\times10^{-19}\,\mathrm{C}$. Calculators are allowed.
enonce_intro_markdown:
Figure 4 shows a simple pulley system used to raise a load of $500\,\mathrm{N}$ onto a storey building under construction by applying an effort of $200\,\mathrm{N}$.

![fig-1](gce-ol-physics-2019-p2-officiel-cameroun_exercice_4_fig_1.png)

figures.legende: Figure 4: a pulley system with three pulleys; a load of $500\,\mathrm{N}$ is raised by an effort of $200\,\mathrm{N}$

incertitudes: Pas de total imprimé par question : `points` de l'exercice = somme des marques imprimées (1 + 2 + 2 + 2).

Fig. 4 : le velocity ratio est lu comme 3 (trois brins de corde tirent le bloc inférieur : brin gauche, brin droit montant à la petite poulie, brin fixé au sommet du bloc inférieur). Le rendement de 83 % et la cohérence MA < VR (2,5 < 3) confirment cette lecture.

questions.enonce_markdown: What is the velocity ratio of the pulley system? *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The velocity ratio equals the **number of rope sections supporting the movable (lower) pulley and the load**. In Figure 4 the rope pulls on the lower block at three places: the left vertical section, the right section going up to the small pulley, and the section fixed to the top of the lower block. So

$\mathrm{VR} = 3$

questions.enonce_markdown: Calculate the mechanical advantage of the pulley system. *[2 marks]*
Calculate the efficiency of the pulley system. *[2 marks]*
State two reasons why the efficiency is less than $100\,\%$. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown: Any two of: (1) **friction** in the pulley bearings and between the rope and the pulleys, so some work is wasted as heat; (2) the **weight of the movable pulley (lower block)**, which has to be lifted as well as the load; (3) the **weight of the rope** and the fact that it stretches.
